npcs.name: Sailor Working On SS Anne Night
npcs.meet_text: I've been working all day I'm absolutely shattered.
npcs.repeat_text: Most passengers went back to the ship earlier but I saw some shady characters actually getting off.

npcs.name: Sailor 2 Pier 1 Night 3
npcs.meet_text: Oh boy I am pooped. Some guys dressed in black headed past this way earlier as if they were going to go to the forest.
npcs.repeat_text: The forest is still closed until morning though so not sure where they were going.

npcs.name: Sailor Working On Dock Night 3
npcs.meet_text: I can't wait for the SS Anne to leave now, I've never been busier.
npcs.repeat_text: Us sailors are hard workers as it is but this is too much for us!

npcs.name: Sabrina NPC
npcs.meet_text: Your town is much quieter than Saffron. I'm Sabrina, I knew you would be coming. You'll be challenging me soon I can see that, but this might help you win against me.
npcs.repeat_text: Good luck with the Gym Hero Challenge. I know you're going to do well.

npcs.name: Koga NPC
npcs.meet_text: Out here in the cover of darkness too? I'm Koga. I was once the Gym Leader of Fuschia and then made it as an Indigo League Elite 4 member. I've been asked here to help in the Gym Hero challenge. As you're out here at this hour you might appreciate this.
npcs.repeat_text: I won't take it easy on you if you come to take the challenge so be prepared.

npcs.name: Giovanni NPC
npcs.meet_text: You shouldn't be out here so late, there's not always nice people wandering around at this hour. I promised not to cause trouble while I'm here but why not a little mischief? As proof I'm not evil, take this.
npcs.repeat_text: I am Giovanni. I was once the leader of Team Rocket and the gym leader in Viridian. Now I'm not formally either, but Team Rocket will always live on.

opponents.name: Card Elder Rayne
opponents.meet_text: Hoh Hoh, are you ready to feel the torrent? If you win I'll give you a medal to prove your triumph.
opponents.repeat_text: Hoh Hoh! I enjoyed the battle that much I'd also like another!
opponents.first_win_text: Congratulations on your win. You've earned this medal and my respect.
opponents.rematch_win_text: Come back any time and battle us old folk.
opponents.loss_text: Don't be disheartened, the rain will always stop.

opponents.name: Card Elder Hamish
opponents.meet_text: Back for the challenge then hey? Remember you'll need to defeat all 3 of us if you want to progress.
opponents.repeat_text: Very well, I always enjoy a good challenge!
opponents.first_win_text: Well done, that was quite the battle. Take my medal and continue forth.
opponents.rematch_win_text: Battling like this makes me feel young again.
opponents.loss_text: Don't be disheartened, the rain will always stop.

opponents.name: Card Elder Waverly
opponents.meet_text: Are you ready to take me on then? If you win then you'll do well in the Gym Hero Challenge.
opponents.repeat_text: Up for another round then? Happy to oblige.
opponents.first_win_text: Well well well, what a jolly good play! You've earned this.
opponents.rematch_win_text: We've been winning and losing for so long it's always fun either way.
opponents.loss_text: When you fail, get up and try again.

opponents.name: Engineer Brad
opponents.meet_text: Hey, I've been working hard all day so I'm ready to play
opponents.repeat_text: It's rare I have to work at night so I'm free for another match.
opponents.first_win_text: I simply cannot fix that at all.
opponents.rematch_win_text: I'm going to weld my cards at this rate.
opponents.loss_text: You just need to work harder

opponents.name: Bad Dude Wayne
opponents.meet_text: I caught these bad looking dudes heading to the forest and they gave me some interesting cards and went on their way.
opponents.first_win_text: You even seen a Dark Pokemon before?
opponents.rematch_win_text: I need some more of these Dark cards.

opponents.name: Psychic Brienne
opponents.meet_text: I love the peace of the harbour at night, the sound of the waves in the dark are really relaxing.
opponents.repeat_text: It's easier to meditate at night.
opponents.first_win_text: I have to focus more. Take these cards to help you focus more too.

opponents.name: Painter Jericho
opponents.meet_text: The evening sun is the most perfect time to come here and paint... or play cards!
opponents.repeat_text: I've been painting a lot of great pieces from this spot.
opponents.first_win_text: A win or a loss, both are equal pieces of art.
opponents.rematch_win_text: A win or a loss, both are equal pieces of art.
opponents.loss_text: To win is a beautiful piece of art.

opponents.name: Firebreather Darryl
opponents.meet_text: I've had plenty of juice so I'm all cooled down and need to get fired up.
opponents.repeat_text: I'm fired up and ready for another match if you want.
opponents.rematch_win_text: I could teach you how to firebreath... but maybe you should teach me how to play cards better!
opponents.loss_text: That juice was just what I needed!

opponents.name: Firebreather Kenneth
opponents.meet_text: We're practicing all night, both firebreathing and pokemon cards!
opponents.repeat_text: If you want another match then let's goooooo.
opponents.first_win_text: I have too many burns to battle well.
opponents.rematch_win_text: I'll just stick to the firebreathing from now on, I'm good at that.
